Project Support

Service & lifecycle support by agreed project scope.

Technical coordination and documentation from pre-delivery review through site support.

Project-facing support

Support can include technical clarification, drawing coordination, FAT and witness arrangements, export documentation, packing and shipping handover, installation guidance, commissioning support and training where contracted.

Scope varies by project, destination, Incoterm and contract. Service items are confirmed in approved technical and commercial documents rather than presented as blanket promises.
